systems.system: Loi n° 019/AN/23/9ème L portant Code Numérique, Livre 7 Titre 2 (accès aux documents administratifs et réutilisation des données publiques, articles 712 to 730)
systems.owner: Republic of Djibouti (law published in JO spécial n° 04, 18 September 2025)

note: The passages shown give only reuse conditions (Art. 727-730) and a yearly published list of main documents (Art. 729) for public information already online, under an access-to-administrative-documents title; they do not say this part sets a rule that public bodies publish their data openly, and name no open data policy or portal, so no fact.
